scope: read-only native/GDB observations and Callgrind instruction counts on Linux fast symbol-bearing binary; no optimization implemented

routing.method: 100/200 iterations, subtract and divide by 100; collect outer driver so THROW restoration outside the loop is included; own instruction counts, not inclusive attribution or elapsed time

success.definition: : B-WORK 1+ ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO ['] B-WORK CATCH DROP LOOP ;

nested-64.definition: : B-NEST DUP IF 1- ['] B-NEST CATCH THROW ELSE DROP THEN ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO 64 ['] B-NEST CATCH + LOOP ;

nested-256.definition: : B-NEST DUP IF 1- ['] B-NEST CATCH THROW ELSE DROP THEN ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO 256 ['] B-NEST CATCH + LOOP ;

execute.definition: : B-WORK 1+ ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO ['] B-WORK ['] CATCH EXECUTE DROP LOOP ;

defer.definition: DEFER B-CATCH ' CATCH IS B-CATCH : B-WORK 1+ ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO ['] B-WORK B-CATCH DROP LOOP ;

synonym.definition: SYNONYM B-CATCH CATCH : B-WORK 1+ ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO ['] B-WORK B-CATCH DROP LOOP ;

throw.definition: : B-WORK 77 THROW ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO ['] B-WORK CATCH + LOOP ;

fast-throw.definition: : B-WORK 77 FAST-THROW ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO ['] B-WORK CATCH + LOOP ;

nobt-throw.definition: : B-WORK 77 THROW ; : BENCH-RUN 0 BENCH-ITERATIONS 0 DO ['] B-WORK CATCH-NOBT + LOOP ;
